newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Bus buys Ken-Air units shares.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Bus buys Ken-Air units shares.

text.p: Singapore Bus Service Ltd (SBS) said on Thursday its subsidiary, SBS Taxi Pte Ltd, has bought out the shares in Ken-Air Leisure Group Pte Ltd for Singapore $4.9 million.

The acquisition comprised 49,000 CityLimo Credit Pte Ltd shares, 24 Ken-Air Care Care Pte Ltd shares, 722,750 CityLimo Leasing Pte Ltd shares and 771,750 CityLimo Rent-A-Car Ltd shares, SBS said in a statement.
SBS Taxi's shareholdings in each of the companies has risen by 20 percent to 100 percent after the purchase, it said.
All the companies purchased are in car rental, car financing and other related businesses and will complement SBS's services.
